description: Grove, the AI gateway, and the control credential Press calls it with. A pool of trial keys is minted ahead under the trial team there, each capped at the trial key cap for its life and retired at the trial key expiry after its first use; a Product Trial site takes one into its site config as ai_keys.

fields.description: The Grove site that serves AI, e.g. https://grove.frappe.cloud.
fields.label: Grove URL

fields.description: What one trial site may spend through its key in all, USD. Sent with every mint; a change applies to keys minted after it.
fields.label: Trial Key Cap (USD)

fields.description: Minted by Grove for Press on Enroll.
fields.label: Control Credentials

fields.description: The Grove Team trial keys are minted under. Registered at Grove on Enroll and again when this name changes; a key keeps the team it was minted under.
fields.label: Trial Team

fields.description: When a trial key retires on its own: so many days after its first request, not after the mint, so a key waiting in the pool does not age. Sent with every mint; a change applies to keys minted after it. Never: trial keys never retire on their own.
fields.label: Trial Key Expiry

fields.description: The Grove geography the pool's keys are minted in, one of Grove's geography names; a key dials that geography's gateway. A key minted earlier keeps its own.
fields.label: Trial Key Geography

fields.description: How many trial keys Press keeps minted and ready for Product Trial sites, under the trial team; a job every 5 minutes refills the pool. 0 keeps the pool off: a trial site then gets no key, and archived sites' keys are still revoked.
fields.label: Trial Pool Size

name: Grove Settings
